grouping: One optimizer update per paragraph; average its one or two row losses; same groups/order for both arms.
sft_loss: mean response-token NLL, then mean over sibling rows within paragraph
reference_policy: exact frozen starting expanded epoch-2 adapter; no raw-base reference and no moving reference
dropout_proposal: disable during both continuation arms and reference scoring; measure initial policy/reference identity
precision: Existing NF4 double quantization, FP32 compute; no fp16 change
primary_final_checkpoint: epoch 2, fixed before execution; epoch 1 diagnostic only
preference_specific_claim: Requires a direct benefit over the matched chosen-only SFT arm; a margin improvement alone is insufficient.
detector_evaluation: Only one frozen quality-qualified checkpoint; use existing paper-balanced rounds and record provider/version/date. No detector-driven tuning.
limits: Small correlated training-only sample and one seed, not a general style benchmark.
Chosen references have greater source overlap in 16/17 pairs and are longer in 12/17.
Equal updates/chosen exposures are not equal compute or objective scale; DPO processes rejected completions too.
Budget is proposed, not authorization; stop for failures rather than silently altering precision, truncating rows or replacing the reference.
